tipping.derived_from: Grundner et al. 2024 is a diagnostic regression for cloud cover, not a bistable or threshold system -- there is no tipping point to declare.

regen.derived_from: No relaxation/recovery concept applies to a diagnostic (non-prognostic) regression equation.

entropy_bg.derived_from: a1-a9/epsilon/rhBar/tBar are regression coefficients, not an energetic or radiative background quantity -- none is reported in the source paper for this slot.
